title: Tinh gọn modal xem bàn 3D và ổn định AR mặt sàn
rootCause: The initial floor-placement fix changed ar-scale to auto so users could resize oversized assets. In Scene Viewer this keeps the model resizable, and native instant/depth tracking transitions can look like the object grows, shrinks or drifts when the device moves closer or farther. The web page cannot control Scene Viewer anchors after handoff. The smallest stable fix is to use fixed physical scale and keep supported devices in WebXR instead of falling through to Scene Viewer.
